permission.project_see: See the project: its catalog, deployments, requests, members, quotas and reports, as they change.
permission.deployments_read_all: See every deployment and request of the project, when its deployments show to their owners only.
permission.request_submit: Request from the project's catalog and save drafts; own deployments there, and move one into it.
permission.request_manage: Cancel, retry and roll back anyone's request in the project.
permission.approval_project: Be one of the project's approvers, asked when a lease is extended beyond its policy; held only from a role given in the project.
permission.project_members_manage: Add and remove the project's members, and change their roles.
permission.project_settings_read: See the project's administration: its placement, quotas and the policies that apply there; for all of rvav, every project's.
permission.project_update: Change the project's details and environments, or archive it.
permission.placement_manage: Change the project's placement rules and Active Directory OUs.
permission.audit_read: Read the audit log: the project's events, or every event for all of rvav.
permission.project_policies_manage: Write the project's own approval, day-2 and lease policies; a global hard policy still wins.
permission.approval_read_all: See every approval, and the questions and answers of composites' waits for a person.
permission.project_create: Create projects, and name their first project admins, themselves included.
permission.access_read: See the roles and who holds them, groups of the identity provider included.
permission.access_manage: Make roles, and give them to users and groups: whoever holds it can give themselves any permission.
permission.catalog_manage: Build, publish and open catalog items, with their categories, secrets, shared variables, Git repository and AWX templates; read what their steps were given and gave.
permission.infrastructure_read: See templates, sizes, network mappings, IP ranges and the vCenters rvav reaches.
permission.infrastructure_manage: Change templates, sizes, network mappings and IP ranges, and reconcile IPAM.
permission.integrations_manage: See, set and test the identity provider and every connection, and make the inventory token and ServiceNow's.
permission.policies_read: See the approval, day-2, lease and naming policies, every project's included.
permission.policies_manage: Change the approval, day-2, lease and naming policies.
permission.extensibility_read: See event subscriptions, their runs, the custom workflows and the custom resource types; read the shared variables and what composite steps were given and gave.
permission.extensibility_manage: Change event subscriptions, custom workflows, custom resource types, AWX day-2 actions and day-2 forms, retry and test runs.
permission.import_manage: Onboard existing VMs and import from vRA.
permission.system_manage: Use the setup checklist and the System page; set the branding and the notification templates.
permission.tokens_manage: See and revoke everyone's API tokens.

day2.accept_changes: Accept the changes made in vCenter

request_submitted.name: Request submitted
request_submitted.when: To the requester, and the owner when on behalf, once a request is submitted.

approval_needed.name: Approval needed
approval_needed.when: To each approver of a level when it opens, is delegated or escalated to them, or a custom workflow asks them.

request_approved.name: Request approved
request_approved.when: To the requester, once the last level approved.

request_rejected.name: Request rejected
request_rejected.when: To the requester, once a level rejected.

request_succeeded.name: Request done
request_succeeded.when: To the owner, and the requester when on behalf, once a request is done.

request_failed.name: Request failed
request_failed.when: To the owner, and the requester when on behalf, once a request failed.

request_rolled_back.name: Request rolled back
request_rolled_back.when: To the owner, once what a failed request built was deleted.

lease_expiring.name: Lease ending
lease_expiring.when: To the deployment's owner, 7 days and 1 day before its lease ends.

lease_expired.name: Lease ended
lease_expired.when: To the deployment's owner, once its lease ended.

owner_changed.name: Deployment handed over
owner_changed.when: To the new owner of a deployment.

step_message.name: Message from a composite
step_message.when: To those a composite's message step names, when it runs.
